privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Baobab keeps your browsing local by default. Optional sync stores bookmarks, history, and chats on Cloudflare's African edge — D1 for structured data, R2 for content. We never sell your data, share it with third parties, or train models on it. Local mode keeps everything on this device; sync only activates when you sign in.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.body: Baobab is alpha software released under the AGPL-3.0 license. It's provided as-is, without warranty. Source code lives at github.com/ghwmelite-dotcom/baobab. By using it you accept that things may break, data may move during the alpha, and we'll fix issues as we find them.
